title: Personal time plan and command word sort
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y11 lesson 56 (Pupil PDF worksheet: personal time plan and command word sort)
intro: Lesson 56: Exam technique: timing, choices and command words. To understand how to manage 150 minutes, choose questions wisely and answer exactly what each command word asks

cards: Events of the Battle of Badr
blocks.title: Sort into: Describe / Explain / Assess
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Describe, Explain, Assess.
blocks.answer: Describe: Features of salah at Jumu'ah; Events of the Battle of Badr. Explain: Why zakah purifies wealth; Why the Hijrah mattered. Assess: 'Hajj is the most important pillar'; 'Belief in al-Qadr removes free will'

questions.q: Turn a weak 'explain' answer into a strong one: 'Salah is important. Muslims pray five times.'
questions.a: For example: Salah is important because it is the second pillar and a direct link with Allah; for example, Allah commands Jumu'ah in 62:9, so Muslims leave trade to pray.
questions.model: Teacher: add a reason (second pillar, link with Allah), then evidence (62:9), then explain (leaving trade shows priority).

questions.q: How many questions do you answer in total?

Timed section in the portal response box: one full Section C question (our own, 4IS1 style: describe, explain, 12-mark assess on 3.1 to 3.5) in 35 minutes, keeping to your time plan; then self-mark with the success criteria.
questions.a: Accurate describe points; developed explain points with evidence; balanced 12-mark with a passage and justified judgement
questions.model: Teacher shows the first two minutes: underline command words, jot the passage, sketch the 12-mark plan.

questions.q: note how long each part took you.
Which part took longer than planned?
